title: TOPA — KEYHOE REVERSE + SPIRAL HIDDEN-DEPENDENCIES AUDIT
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.

method.reverse: CURRENT_VERDICT -> SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE -> SOURCE_GENEALOGY -> HIDDEN_DEPENDENCIES -> ALTERNATIVE_CAUSES -> FALSIFIERS -> REVISED_VERDICT
method.spiral: A0 -> B0 -> C0 -> ASCEND -> A1 -> B1 -> C1 -> ASCEND -> A2

spiral_mapping.A0: freeze current verdict without defending it
spiral_mapping.B0: walk backward to earliest surviving source and separate primary from retelling
spiral_mapping.C0: identify strongest ordinary and extraordinary competing models
spiral_mapping.ASCEND_0: write correction receipt for every assumption that changed
spiral_mapping.A1: draw causal-independence graph between witnesses, sensors and publications
spiral_mapping.B1: normalize time zones, coordinates, geometry, instrument limitations and missing raw data
spiral_mapping.C1: state observations that would lower confidence in each model
spiral_mapping.A2: compare hidden failure modes across cases and export new TOPA rules

hidden_findings.finding: Radar, airborne ELINT and visual testimony are physically different channels, but channel diversity is not automatically causal-source independence. The RB-47 ELINT equipment was designed to direction-find radar emissions; therefore a ground-radar emitter can be causally upstream of an ELINT detection. A three-channel label must not be counted as three independent causes without a dependency graph.
evidence: Condon Case 5 describes visual, airborne radar-monitoring receiver and ground-radar reports.
The intercepted signal was radar-like in the S-band region and the ELINT monitors were direction-finding receivers rather than independent range-measuring radars.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Reconstruct whether the reported ground-radar station characteristics, scan rate, frequency, azimuth and timing could produce any or all ELINT episodes.

hidden_findings.finding: The Condon investigation failed to locate event records and initially worked with a wrong date. Its 'unidentified' outcome is therefore partly an epistemic state created by unavailable records and delayed reconstruction, not positive evidence for an exotic origin.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Acquire and cross-index the 745th ACWRON TWX, 55th SRW intelligence summary, Airborne Observer Data Sheet, Duncanville logs and original crew statements by timestamp.

hidden_findings.finding: The famous statement that the F-89 and target blips 'merged' is instrument-space language. Two targets inside radar resolution can render as one return. Keyhoe's narrative converted an instrument-resolution event into an apparent physical-contact narrative.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Reconstruct AN/FPS-3 range/azimuth resolution at the final slant range and propagate both target uncertainty ellipses.

hidden_findings.finding: The target was reported by U.S. controllers as an RCAF C-47/VC-912; later research includes a claimed C-47 pilot recollection. Any mismatch among U.S. and Canadian records is a target-identification/provenance problem. It cannot be promoted to a nonhuman target merely because records disagree.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Obtain RCAF 412 Squadron logbooks, aircrew logbook copy, flight plan, Canadian ATC/radio records and USAF intercept order side by side.

hidden_findings.finding: The F-89C had documented structural, engine, icing and operational limitations; another F-89C from the same broader unit environment crashed only hours earlier. This does not explain Moncla's loss, but it raises the prior probability of an aviation failure and must be included before an extraordinary model is scored.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Compare weather, icing layers, engine restrictions, descent profile, fuel state and known F-89C failure modes to last known trajectory.

hidden_findings.finding: Egypt had returned to standard time by October 1, 1957. A reported 01:30 local sighting on December 1 corresponds approximately to 23:30 UTC on November 30. The SL-1 R/B catalog supplies a decay date of 1957-12-01 but not a terminal timestamp in the cited catalog. Therefore 'same calendar date' is not a closed temporal match.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Recover final tracking bulletin/TLE/state vector and exact decay epoch, then propagate through 31.2469N 27.8547E with observer horizon geometry.

hidden_findings.finding: Archival 1941 New Zealand/8th Army routine orders document weapon-training practices at Ras el-Kanayis with firing directions toward the sea. This proves historical military use of the area, not military activity in 1957. It creates a legitimate alternative-search lane but is not an explanation by itself.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Search Egyptian, British and regional NOTAM, naval gunnery, air-force exercise and range records specifically for 1957-11-30/12-01.

hidden_findings.finding: The candidate object is the launch rocket body SL-1 R/B, NORAD 1, 1957-001A, whose catalog decay date is 1957-12-01. Sputnik 1 itself is NORAD 2, 1957-001B, and decayed in January 1958. Treating 'Sputnik' as one object silently merges payload and launch stage.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Use NORAD/COSPAR object identifiers in every orbital hypothesis.

hidden_findings.case: Keyhoe / Piri Reis / Egypt-adjacent ancient-visitor argument
hidden_findings.finding: Keyhoe's 1960 presentation explicitly routes crucial map claims through A. H. Mallery and a Hydrographic Office discussion. Later authors repeating Keyhoe/Mallery/Hapgood form a citation lineage, not multiple independent confirmations of an anomalous map.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Build claim genealogy Mallery -> Keyhoe -> Hapgood/later authors and score only genuinely independent cartographic analyses as corroboration.

hidden_findings.finding: Keyhoe's early Egyptian mummy/Tutankhamun pulp fiction and later UFO/ancient-map speculation are real biographical motifs but do not establish a continuous hidden evidentiary program. Fictional recurrence must remain separate from factual source lineage.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Cross-link fiction only as cultural provenance, never as support for archaeological or UAP claims.

hidden_findings.finding: Real classification, inconsistent public statements or broadcast control can establish information control without identifying the classified content. Cold War balloons, radar, air-defense and intelligence programs are alternative reasons for secrecy.
hidden_findings.next_gate: For each secrecy claim, freeze exactly what document/information was withheld before inferring why.

hidden_findings.finding: A corpus intentionally built from the hardest unresolved cases is an extreme-value sample. Its unresolved fraction cannot estimate how common genuinely anomalous phenomena are without the denominator of ordinary/resolved reports.
hidden_findings.next_gate: Where possible, preserve total reports, screened-out conventional cases, unresolved count and selection criteria.

egypt_registry_crosslinks.guard: No direct historical link between Donald Keyhoe and the JANUS Mendes/Osiris artifact chain was established in this pass. Cross-link only the shared evidence methods: provenance, exact mapping, negative results, source independence and spiral correction.

priority_open_gates.success_condition: Propagatable terminal elements with documented epoch close enough to test the Egypt sightline.

priority_open_gates.success_condition: Demonstrate which observations are genuinely independent and which could share a radar emitter or reporting chain.
Identify or exclude the reported C-47 target with primary logs.

priority_open_gates.target: Military/NOTAM/range activity around Ras el-Kanayis on 1957-11-30/12-01
priority_open_gates.success_condition: Primary dated record confirms or excludes a relevant exercise/launch/firing window.
Each major claim has earliest located source, later derivative publications and truly independent checks labeled separately.

compact_result: The reverse spiral did not reveal a hidden single explanation. It revealed hidden dependencies: duplicated sources, non-independent sensor channels, timezone boundaries, instrument-resolution language becoming physical narrative, and historical context being mistaken for event-date evidence. TOPA therefore becomes stricter while preserving genuinely unresolved residues.
